subject: [RFC PATCH 5/5] xfs: track mmap dirty state per block

2026-09-03.patch_summary: This patch modifies the XFS file system to track the dirty state of memory-mapped blocks individually, rather than at the folio (2M) level. This change is made possible by replacing the `dirty_folio` operation with a new `dirty_folio_range` operation that allows for more precise tracking of dirty blocks. As a result, when writing data to a shared mapping, only the affected block is written back instead of the entire folio.
